question: A ray of light in air is incident at an angle of 60° on the surface separating air from a medium of refractive index sqrt3.The ray is refracted in the medium at an angle of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**30°.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** incident angle is 60 degrees**, which is greater than the critical angle of 45 degrees for air in the given medium. Therefore, the ray will be refracted into the medium.
